templates.name: Create sample cable tray
templates.description: Creates a five-point, four-segment sample cable tray on story 0 at 2.50m above the home story with a 0.20m x 0.10m rectangular cross section.

plan.title: Create sample cable tray
plan.warning: This template writes to the Archicad model. Auto mode executes directly; supervised and manual modes require confirmation.

steps.title: Create story-0 sample cable tray
steps.description: Create the five-point route from live-read parameters using the source cable tray's native coordinates (no offset).
steps.expectedResult: Creates one CableCarrier route using the project's default CableCarrier system and a 0.20m x 0.10m cross section.

parameters.expected: Five waypoints, four rectangular segments, 2.50m above the home story
Uses project default CableCarrier system, width=0.20m, height=0.10m

templates.notes: Parameters come from the current AC28 story-0 CableCarrier read/recreate regression. The path uses the source cable tray's native coordinates (no X offset) while preserving the route and uniform cross section. The MEP system is not hardcoded (no index, no name); the command uses the project's default CableCarrier system, which is stable across Chinese/English projects and AC28/AC29 (both attribute index and system name are project-specific, so hardcoding either fails in some projects).

templates.name: Replicate stair and landing slab to floors 2 and 3
templates.description: Replicates the two-flight stair and landing slab (TPL-003 parameters) to floor index 1 and 2 (the 2nd and 3rd stories). Same plan position; relative-to-story heights are preserved (landing level=1.5m, lower flight baseLevel=0m, upper flight baseLevel=1.5m). Six steps: 2 landing slabs + 4 stair flights. dryRun=false creates directly.

templates.name: Create outer walls and slab on floors 2 and 3
templates.description: Create 4 outer walls + 1 slab on each of floors 2 and 3 (10 steps total). Wall parameters come from measured geometry (thickness 0.3m, height 3m); slab is a 15.55x14.55m rectangle (level=0m, thickness=0.3m). Each step is self-contained with coordinates, no GUID dependency, works across projects. dryRun=false creates directly.

templates.notes: Creation-based template: build the outer shell on floors 2/3 using CreateWall x4 + CreateSlab x1 per floor. Parameters come from measured ground-floor geometry (GetElementGeometry); each step is self-contained with coordinates, no GUID dependency, works across projects. Consistent with tpl-starter-room-walls (4 CreateWall) and tpl-starter-scan-structure (CreateSlab). Replaced the previous "copy" template because CopyElements with empty sourceGuids is blocked at three layers (resolver / schema minItems / C++ NO_SOURCE_GUIDS).
